references.text: The original instruction to make the tabernacle (mishkan) with its coverings and cloths, which is now to be carried out by the craftsmen.
Detailed instructions for the planks (qerashim), bars (berichim), pillars (ammudim), and sockets (adanim) mentioned in this verse.
Instructions for making the clasps (qerasim) of gold and copper that were to hold the tent curtains together.
The description of the actual execution of the work on the tabernacle, the tent curtain, the covering, the clasps, the planks, the bars, the pillars, and the sockets.
The raising of the tabernacle with all its components, including the covering and the tent over it.
The responsibility of the Gershonites to carry the tabernacle's coverings, cloths, and curtains during the wilderness journey.
The responsibility of the Merarites to carry the planks, bars, pillars, and sockets of the tabernacle.
The first tent (tabernacle) is described in Hebrews as a shadow of the heavenly one, where Christ serves in the true tabernacle.
Compares the building instructions with the later transport and service distribution of the same components.
Distinguishes between the physical structure (Ex 35) and the holy content/placement of the ark (Ex 31).
Summarizes the entire construction process and confirms that all details were essential for the service.
